meta.title: The Old Town Trail
meta.textType: a descriptive text about a place

paragraphs: The Old Town Trail, posted by Lily. The old town trail is a short walk through the oldest part of our town. The walk takes about one hour, and it starts at the town library. The Explorers walk the trail every year. The trail is not long, so children can walk it. Do you know the old part of your town? This post describes the trail for our readers.

The buildings on the trail have a lot of character. Most of them are old wooden shops with painted doors. Some doors are green, some are blue, and some are red. In the morning, the light makes the colors bright. A cat sleeps on one of the steps. The street is small, so the shops are very close to each other. Each building has its own story, and each one looks different.

Many tourists walk on the trail at the weekend. They take photos, and they buy small gifts in the shops. Many of them also eat rice noodles at a small shop on the trail. Some tourists come from other towns, and some come from other countries. In the middle of the trail, there is a small museum. It shows old photos, old tools, and a model of the town. It is quiet inside, and the floor is cool. The museum gives a discount to children, and the price is half. It is open on Saturday and Sunday.

The town library helps the visitors. It lends free maps of the trail at the front desk. A kind woman at the desk gives out the maps. In the hot season, it also lends umbrellas, and you can take one for the walk. Please bring the map and the umbrella back by five o'clock. Many local people walk the trail in their spare time. They like the shade of the old trees. Some people sit on the benches and read.

The trail is clean, because many people take action. The people in the shops sweep the street every morning. Once a month, the Explorers pick up litter on the trail. Mia takes photos before and after the work. A small sign on each bin says thank you. Please put your litter in a bin, and help to keep the trail nice. Would you like to walk the trail with us?
text.summary: Lily describes the old town trail for the readers of Explorers' Blog. She tells about the old buildings, the tourists, the small museum with a discount for children, the library that lends maps, and how the Explorers help to keep the trail clean.
